en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Romanesque‑style cathedral with four tall corner towers and an arcaded façade, fronted by a broad square with trees and a central statue. Hills and town buildings lie in the background. The reverse side is printed as a divided postcard with Hungarian heading "LEVELEZŐ LAP", a Hungarian stamp and postmark, multilingual caption identifying the view, and handwritten Hungarian text and address.
